freedSub: Turned human again and went home through the portal
kidJoin: Your son is by your side now: he throws sparks at the monsters
endSub: The Endless Rift is open: islands go on forever, each one stronger
resetNote: A new story has arrived! Everyone restarts from Mars. Your coins and purchases are kept.
st0: The portal hurled Serhat into a red desert. Far away, in a cage on a monster's back, his son's light flickers.
st1: Bat shrieks among the ice shards. This planet smells familiar… blood and his brother's cologne.
st2: Volcanoes shake the ground. A voice echoes: "Dad, I'm here!" But someone stands before it: the one who opened the rift.
st3: Giant footprints in the orange fog. The creatures pass the cage from hand to hand, and every hand belongs to someone he knows.
st4: Beneath acid clouds lies the creatures' market. Everything here is for sale, even people.
st5: The storm never stops. The slyest haggler of all hides the cage key here.
st6: In the shadow of the rings, the cage workshop. The cages carrying his son were forged here.
st7: Planet of blue winds. A man is fighting himself: half friend, half foe.
st8: The island closest to the sun. The cage changed hands one last time; now it's with the kidnappers' boss.
st9: Cables hum in the icy dark. His son listens to a cable: "This line powers a whole city, Dad."
st10: A thick line runs beneath purple forests. Each guard that falls lights up a city on Earth again.
st11: Ice geysers cool the cables. The guards' faces are familiar: the neighbourhood's craftsmen.
st12: Under a red sun, the craftsmen are chained. Zülfü wired them to the cable.
st13: A tiny world covered in rocks. You can feel the Grid Eater's pulse through the ground.
st14: The last main line, on an ocean world. Half of Earth is dark. We must find the main switch.
st15: At the heart of the diamond planet, the Grid Eater waits. The main switch is in its chest.
st16: The neighbourhood lies scattered across the void. The Queen transformed everyone again. This time you'll save them for good.
st17: A brother waits on Ganymede's ice. This time the vampire curse must end.
st18: Ice volcanoes that flow backwards. The Queen made the worst traitors her guards.
st19: A fast-spinning egg-shaped world. The Queen's eggs are here; each one a new monster.
st20: Here the sun is just another star. In the dark, only Serhat's cable glows.
st21: Under another sun, the two-souled man has split in two again.
st22: On the edge of the black hole, time slows down. Uncle Abdülkadir stands at the gate.
st23: Hive World. The Hive Queen sits on her throne. The neighbourhood's last light shines in her crown.
bi0_0: Serhat… come… I've been waiting. You were like a brother to me.
bi0_1: Hüseyin? What did they do to you?
bi0_2: They gave me power! I never get tired, never get hungry… I just eat!
bi0_3: Where's my son? Talk, or I'll eat you too.
bo0_0: Serhat… forgive me… I lost myself for a moment.
bo0_1: They gave the cage to your brother Fuat. On the icy planet…
bi1_1: Big bro… I'm so thirsty. The aliens took me and drained my veins.
bi1_2: Now all I want is blood. Your blood… smells familiar, bro.
bi1_3: I'm getting you out of here. Even if I have to pull your fangs first.
bo1_0: Bro… the thirst is gone… but the curse isn't.
bo1_1: Zülfü took the cage. He started all of this, bro!
bi2_0: Welcome, Serhat. I opened the rift. Didn't you know?
bi2_1: Why, Zülfü? We grew up on the same street!
bi2_2: You were always the master, I was always the apprentice. They offered me power. I took it.
bi2_3: And your son is my bargaining chip.
bo2_0: This isn't over, Serhat! I've plugged into a bigger grid!
bo2_2: Ask your uncle! Özcan sold you out years ago. Hahaha!
bi3_1: I never changed, nephew. I just took off my mask.
bi3_2: I told them where your son was. They paid me in gold.
bi3_3: I'll swallow your gold and you with it.
bo3_0: Stop! Stop! I sold the cage to Fatih! Under the acid clouds!
bo3_1: You sold your own blood, uncle.
bi4_0: Serhat! Partner! Let's make a deal.
bi4_2: The world can burn for all I care. I deal with whoever pays most.
bi4_3: The aliens promised me all of Earth's electricity! What can you offer?
bo4_0: Okay, okay! Fahri has the key! I'll sell him out too, just let me go!
bi5_0: The key? Right here. The price is your life.
bi5_1: Fahri, you watched this kid grow up!
bi5_2: I love children. I love them more when I'm selling them.
bo5_0: The key broke! Cebrail will forge the cage again…
bo5_2: He's their blacksmith now. In Saturn's rings.
bi6_0: I forged these cages, Serhat. Nothing I make ever breaks.
bi6_1: Your hands used to make the neighbourhood's gates.
bi6_2: Now I make their prisons. They pay better.
bo6_0: The cage's weak spot… electricity. Your current will melt it.
bo6_1: But watch out for Necmettin. There are two people inside him.
bo6_2: Thanks, master. Better late than never.
bi7_0: Serhat! Run! My evil side woke up, I can't hold it back!
bi7_1: Silence, weak half! This body is mine now!
bi7_2: Beat him, Serhat… but don't kill me…
bi7_3: Hang on, Necmettin. I'll split you two apart.
bo7_0: My evil side is asleep… for now.
bo7_1: Uncle Abdülkadir has your son. On Mercury, right by the sun.
bo7_2: The last cage. I'm coming, son.
bi8_0: So you made it this far, Serhat. You beat them all.
bi8_1: Uncle Abdülkadir… you were everyone's elder.
bi8_2: That's why they chose me. Elders tell the best lies.
bo8_2: Dad… I heard why they took me. They're going to suck up Earth's electricity.
bo8_3: Zülfü is running cables out of our neighbourhood. We have to stop him!
bo8_4: Then we go together. An electrician's son becomes an electrician.
bi9_1: Dad, that's big brother Şiyar! His eyes are empty.
bi9_2: Zülfü wired him to the cable. Cut the line and he'll wake up.
bo9_0: Serhat? Where am I? There was a buzzing in my head…
bo9_2: One line down. Plenty more to go.
bi10_0: Current… must… flow… don't stop it…
bi10_2: I'll throw my spark at him, Dad!
bo10_0: My son… no, your son… he's grown.
bo10_1: Go home, Samet. The portal's open.
bi11_0: Master… Serhat… did they wire you too?
bi11_1: No, Rasim. I came to cut the line.
bi11_2: You can't cut it… the cable's live…
bo11_0: My head's clear. Zülfü is using us like batteries, Serhat.
bi12_0: Stay back, Serhat. The current made me beautiful.
bi12_1: Big sis Dilan, you weren't like this!
bi12_2: That's alien beauty for you. Rotten on the inside.
bo12_0: Thank you… my chains are loose.
bo12_1: Zeynep is in the ocean. She's holding the main line.
bi13_0: This line won't break, Serhat. Half of Earth runs on this cable.
bi13_1: That's exactly why I'm breaking it, Zeynep.
bi13_2: Dad, the switch is behind her!
bo13_1: Zülfü is on the diamond planet. He welded himself to the grid.
bi14_1: Dad, it's a machine! An alien transformer!
bi14_2: I install and remove transformers for a living. This is just another one.
bo14_1: The Grid Eater's heart is on the next island!
bi15_0: Look at me, Serhat! I AM the grid now!
bi15_1: All of Earth's lights flow through my veins!
bi15_2: And I came to flip the main switch, Zülfü.
bi15_3: Dad, the switch in his chest!
bo15_1: Dad, every city is lit up!
bo15_3: Dad… the rift is opening again! The neighbourhood… it's lifting into the sky!
bo15_4: The Hive Queen. She's stealing the neighbourhood!
bi16_0: Serhat… the Queen called me again… I can't resist.
bi16_1: This time I'll free you for good, my friend.
bo16_0: The voice is gone… no one in my head. I'm free!
bo16_1: Go home, my friend. Tea's on me.
bi17_0: Bro… the Queen gave me back my thirst…
bi17_1: We end this curse today, brother.
bi17_2: Uncle Fuat, my dad's gonna save you!
bo17_0: I can feel the sun, bro… my fangs are gone!
bi18_0: Nephew! The Queen gave me a palace!
bo18_0: Fine… fine… I want to go home.
bo18_1: Go home, uncle. But the neighbourhood won't forget.
bi19_0: Serhat! I'm selling the Queen's eggs, one city apiece!
bi19_2: We're shutting down the shop, Fatih.
bo19_0: Alright, alright… I'm bankrupt. Take me home too.
bo19_1: The portal's open to everyone, Fatih. Even people like you.
bi20_0: No one can find you in this dark, Serhat. If I sold you, no one would hear.
bi20_1: I can see you, Uncle Fahri. My dad is glowing.
bi20_2: My cable shines in the dark too.
bo20_0: The light… my eyes… fine, I give up.
bo20_1: Go home, and never sell anyone again.
bi21_0: Serhat, I've split in two again!
bi21_1: This time I'll devour the good half completely!
bi21_2: I came to bring you two back together. But the bad one's getting smaller.
bo21_0: I only have one voice now. My own.
bo21_1: Uncle Abdülkadir is at the Queen's gate. Save him too.
bi22_0: Serhat… this time the Queen forced me.
bi22_1: If I open the gate, the whole neighbourhood dies. If I don't, I die.
bi22_2: Nobody's dying, uncle. I'll open it.
bo22_0: The gate is open. The Queen awaits you.
bo22_1: Dad, we made it to the end.
bo22_2: We came together, we go home together.
bi23_0: Little electrician. You ate all my children.
bi23_1: Now your neighbourhood will become my hive.
bi23_2: Dad! The neighbourhood's light is in her crown!
bi23_3: I lit that light, Queen. I'm taking it back.
bo23_0: Your current… it can't be this strong…
bo23_1: Dad! The crown went dark! Everyone's waking up!
bo23_2: Come on, son. We're going home.
bo23_3: Dad… the rift didn't close. Something is watching from the deep.
bo23_4: Let it watch. An electrician is always on duty.
